desc:
**Manage Projects To Perfection**

Big dreams turn into bigger results with a killer project plan. Use this basic structure to build your team's ideal workflow, for projects big or small.

Here's what's included, and how to get this project management party started:

1. **Resources (Start Here!):**
This list is perfect for you and your team to have all those documents, specs, designs, or anything you tend to reference all the time. Meeting schedules and answers to common questions are also recommended to pop into this list so that your team is informed at all times. 📚

2. **Questions For Next Meeting:**
Never again forget that important question you thought of in the shower this morning! Slide your Q's into this handy list so your team keeps on flowing. 🌊

3. **To Do:**
The mother of all lists—the good ol' To Do. This is where assigned tasks live so that your team can see who's working on what and when it's due. Crystal clear all day, week, and month. 🔮

4. **Pending:**
We all have those in-between tasks that are technically done but also awkwardly waiting for another step. That's where the Pending list comes into play, use this list to share what those next mini-steps are with your team. 💬

5. **Blocked:**
With any successful project comes at least one inevitable blocker. Splash those red-tape, blocking issues that are slowing your team down so you can tackle it in the best way; together. 🚷

6. **Done:**
Our favorite list, the Done list. Stop, drag, and drop! For all your finished tasks that your team has hustled on and feels proud of. ✨

listing.description:
# Bulk Card Editor for Trello

Edit multiple Trello cards at once with a spreadsheet-like interface. Save time and maintain consistency across your entire board.

#### Free version: Users can select 5 cards at a time and update or export those cards.

#### Paid version: Users can select unlimited cards and update or export as many cards at a time as needed.

---

## ✏️ Bulk Editing

Update multiple cards in a single operation

Edit any card property:

- Lists
- Labels
- Due dates
- Members
- Descriptions
- Custom fields

![screenshot-main.png](https://ormisolutions.com/bulkeditpro/screenshot-main.png)

![screenshot-edit.png](https://ormisolutions.com/bulkeditpro/screenshot-edit.png)

---

## 🔧 Custom Fields Support

Edit custom fields across multiple cards

Full support for all field types:

- Text
- Numbers
- Dates
- Checkboxes
- Dropdowns

---

## 📊 CSV Export

Export cards to CSV format with one click

- Choose which columns to include
- Open directly in Excel or Google Sheets

![screenshot-export.png](https://ormisolutions.com/bulkeditpro/screenshot-export.png)

---

## 🔍 Filtering System

Create advanced filters based on any property

Combine multiple conditions for precise results

Filter by:

- Text content
- Labels
- Members
- Dates
- Custom fields
- And more...

![screenshot-filtering.png](https://ormisolutions.com/bulkeditpro/screenshot-filtering.png)

---

## 📌 Smart Views

- Save frequently used filters as views
- Customize column configurations per view
- Quick access to your most important data

![screenshot-saved-views-1.png](https://ormisolutions.com/bulkeditpro/screenshot-saved-views-1.png)

![screenshot-saved-views-2.png](https://ormisolutions.com/bulkeditpro/screenshot-saved-views-2.png)

---

## 💎 Premium Features

- Unlimited card editing
- Advanced custom field support
- Priority customer support

Perfect for project managers, product owners, and anyone who needs to maintain large Trello boards efficiently.

---

## Getting Started

- After you add the Power-Up please make sure you refresh your browser.
- Click the board button and authorize the application like you would any other Power-Up.
- Click the board button and authorize the application like you would any other Power-Up.

Once you have authorized the Power-Up, you are all set!

---

## Board button not showing up?

Trello Power-Ups require third-party cookies to be enabled in order to function properly. If you're experiencing issues with our Power-Up, please check your browser settings to ensure that third-party cookies are allowed for both:

- Trello: [https://trello.com](https://trello.com "smartCard-inline")
- Our Power-Up domain: [https://trellobulkeditpro.netlify.app/](https://trellobulkeditpro.netlify.app/ "smartCard-inline")

---

## Troubleshooting

Below you can find solutions to the most common issues. If you have not found the answer you are looking for, please don't hesitate to contact [Support](https://ormisolutions.com/bulkeditpro/support/ "‌") or visit our website [https://ormisolutions.com/bulkeditpro/](https://ormisolutions.com/bulkeditpro/ "smartCard-inline")

**How to check in Chrome:**

1. Click the padlock icon to the left of the address bar.
2. Select "Cookies" to manage site-specific permissions.

---

## Additional Notes

Some browser extensions, VPNs, incognito/private browsing, or unsupported browsers may block or alter cookie settings.

Disabling these features or switching to a supported browser may help resolve the issue.

listing.description:
Trello Import by [Blue Cat](https://www.bluecatreports.com/ "‌") lets you import cards from CSV or Excel spreadsheets directly into your Trello boards.

_Hey! we're one of the _[_fastest growing power-ups of 2022_](https://www.bluecatreports.com/blog/power-up-stats-2022/ "‌")_ and _[_2023_](https://www.bluecatreports.com/blog/power-up-stats-2023/ "‌")_!_

## Watch the video!

We're very happy that Brittany from [How I Trello](https://trello.substack.com/ "‌") created this short video showing how to use the power-up. [Watch it here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZkPKD9TNy1M "‌").

![imports\_youtube.png](https://imports.bluecatreports.com/listing/imports_youtube.png)

## How to import into Trello

![select-file.png](https://imports.bluecatreports.com/listing/select-file.png)

1. Add the Trello Import Power-Up to your board
2. Open the CSV or Excel file you want to import
3. Select how to map your data into Trello
4. Click the import button and wait as we create all your cards for you

## Select how we map your data into Trello

![mappings.png](https://imports.bluecatreports.com/listing/mappings.png)

For each column in your spreadsheet, you can select how we will import it into your Trello board. For data you don't want to match to a specific field in Trello you can simply add it to the card description.

If there is data we cannot import we will show that here so you can see what the issue is. You can expand sections to get additional information. To correct these errors you will either need to create the matching List/Label/Custom Field/etc on your Trello board or update your spreadsheet to change those values to match Trello. Or, you can ignore those issues and import the spreadsheet without that data.

## Importing CSV, Excel and Google Sheets data to Trello

Excel files saved as XLSX can be opened and imported. To import from Google Sheets you will need to save your file as a CSV file from google sheets, which can then be opened and imported.

The first row of the spreadsheet is used as headings so we know how to map the data into Trello.

You can take a look at a [simple example spreadsheet here](https://imports.bluecatreports.com/listing/Example%20Import%20Spreadsheet.csv "‌") or any export created from in Trello can be imported using this power-up

We can handle all of these field names, they will be mapped into Trello as described below.

- name, title or card name: Any of these will be mapped to the **card name**
- description, card description or desc: Any of these will map to the **card description**
- list: the **name of the list** we should import this card into. If we cannot find that list the card is created in the first list on the board
- members: the names of the members to assign this card to
- labels: the names and/or colours of the labels to add to this card
- due or due date: maps to the card due date

  - Checklist item: The **Checklist item name**
  - Checklist item due: The **due date** for this checklist item

##Add labels by clicking the "Labels" button on the right -->##

##What are labels?##

Labels are great ways to differentiate the type of tasks your team has.

For example: 

(yellow) **Copy Request:** Any doc, task, or page that needs a grammatical overview or general words in order for it to be done.

(red) **Priority:** This task needs to be finished first before anything else gets done. Communicate the urgency with this handy label.

(purple) **Design Team:** Use this label to indicate that the design team is involved in some capacity so there's never any confusion.

(green) **Halp:** A hilarious plea? Yes. A useful indication? Definitely. Labels can be used for anything, including an indication that someone needs assistance with a task.

**Bonus**
Notice the patterns on the labels: designed for those that may not be able to see colors properly.
